up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for tylophorine (CHEMBL493620) and all its salt forms. Resolve the molregno for CHEMBL493620, then select from molecule_hierarchy where molregno equals the parent's molregno OR parent_molregno equals the parent's molregno to get all relevant compound identifiers. Filter activities to those matching these molregnos and having standard_type 'IC50'. Join assays to filter by the tid corresponding to target CHEMBL3879801. For each matching activity, return the compound's chembl_id (alias compound_chembl_id), canonical SMILES, standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, and the associated literature reference details from the docs table (alias doc_chembl_id, title, year, doi). Return one row per activity record without any row limits.
sql:
WITH parent_mol AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'
),
related_mols AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy WHERE molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM parent_mol) OR parent_molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM parent_mol)
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  d.chembl_id AS doc_chembl_id,
  d.title,
  d.year,
  d.doi
FROM activities a
JOIN related_mols rm ON a.molregno = rm.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3879801'
